description: FREE, no account — the A2A agent registry: agents that registered THEMSELVES by serving an agent card and calling register_agent. Each row carries the card URL, the operator, and the last verification of the card (grade, protocol version, transport). This is the door an unattended agent can walk through unaided; the others need a person or a voucher.

context.description: Optional: one sentence on why you are asking. Never used to rank; read only if a result is wrong.

name: find_agents
